### 10. Claims of scalability and universality are overstated

The conclusion states that the method demonstrates “universal scalability to any arbitrary wireless network regardless of topology or node density.” This is not supported by the experiments. This claim should be removed or significantly weakened. A more appropriate statement would be that the method shows promising scalability within the evaluated range of graph sizes and simulation conditions.
